## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes
- [ ] Fixture script exists and is executable — Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-implementation-plan-step2-remediation.sh
- [ ] Fixture script passes against the updated SKILL.md — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-implementation-plan-step2-remediation.sh
- [ ] SKILL.md Step 2 section contains a 'Remediation Re-dispatch' subsection heading
- [ ] Step 2 subsection contains literal model: "opus"
- [ ] Step 2 subsection references dso:approach-proposer as re-dispatch target
- [ ] Step 2 subsection passes artifacts by reference (absolute path)
- [ ] Step 2 subsection declares mode: remediation
- [ ] Step 2 subsection ends with SC5 single-comment instruction
